tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /drang srong gi bstod pa'o/ /de nas drang srong chen po la bstod pa 'di gsungs so/ /hrīḥ khyab mjug chen po sgra gcan 'dzin/ /'jigs pa'i lus la 'bar ba'i klong*/ / 'jig rten khams kyi drag rtsal can/ /sprul pa chen po mi bsrun pa/ /gnam lcags thog gi bdag po ste/ /skyin thang ser ba 'bebs pa'i gtso/ /drang srong chen po rdzu 'phrul can/ /ri rab steng du lha yi gtso/ /rgya mtsho'i steng du klu yi bdag /bar snang khams su bskyod tsa na/ /lha srin sde brgyad rnams dang bsdongs/ /lus gcig mgo dgu srid gsum gtso/ /mgo gcig lha srin khros pa'i zhal/ /nyi ma zla ba grib mas gnon/ /gcig ni bzhad cing dgod pa'i zhal/ /dgyes pas bka' yi bya ra mdzad/ /gcig ni khros pa srin po'i gdong*/ /gdugs pa'i dgra bgegs zas su za/ /gcig ni rngam zhing za byed gdong*/ /gnam lcags me yi thogs chen 'bebs/ /gcig ni 'jigs byed ma rungs pa/ /tsha grang 'thab pa'i skan sgra sgrogs/ /gcig ni 'khrugs byed 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /g.yo 'gul chen po'i ser ba 'bebs/ /gcig ni gtum byed ye shes zhal/ /mngon shes nus mthu thogs med ston/ /gcig ni las rnams rdzu 'phrul gdong*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung bar byed/ /gcig ni zhi ba lha yi zhal/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ hrīḥkhyod ni chos skyong chen po ste/ /steng gi phyogs na bya rog zhal/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod par byed/ /rwa yi mda' gzhu bsnams pa ni/ /sdang byed dgra bo sgrol ba'i rtags/ /chu srin zhags pa bsnams pa ni/ /sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul ba'i rtags/ /sku la mig gis gang ba ni/ /phyogs bcur bstan pa skyong ba'i rtags/ khyod ni bdud 'dul chen po ste/ dpal ldan mgon po'i las mkhan mchog /re ma ti yi pho nya che/ /e ka tsa ti'i bka' sdod de/ /he ru ka yi sprul pa nyid/ /rdo rje 'chang gis dbang bskur nas/

/dkyil 'khor bcug cing dam la btags/ /sring mo gdong mo mched bzhir bcas/ /king kang rngam pa'i las byed ma/ /cho 'phrul 'gyed cing bstan pa bsrungs/ /bha ling gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo la/ /thog ser dbab pa'i dus la babs/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces gsungs so/ /'di khrag mtsho khol ma'i rgyud nas drang srong chen po la bstod pa gsungs pa rdzogs so// //gza' sgrub pa'i gnad yig /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di sgrub pa'i gnad yig ni/ /gdams ngag gnad thems shin tu gces/ /rdzas gnad dmigs gnad sngags gnad do/ /rdzas ni blo rdo man ngag bzhin/ / dmigs pa rang nyid rā hu la/ /'jigs pa'i thugs ka k+ṣa nag las/ /'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kya/ི /thugs ka nyid nas ye shes kyi/ / gza' bdud spyan drangs bdag la bstim/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar 'brub khung dbus/ /gza' bdud tshon gang gzhung bzhin bskyed/ /'bod sngags nyer gcig bzlas pa yis/ /rgyu ba'i phyogs nas gza' byung nas/ /de nyid la ni thim par bsam/ /gtor ma dbul zhing thun rdzas mchod/ /bstod nas 'bod sngags zhag bdun bzlas/ /hrī shag ru ram̐/ nā ga tsit+ta traṃ/ ma ma yong za/ 'gram ha hi/ yo gi sha la dza dzaḥ de ltar bzlas pas dngos su 'ongs/ /gang 'dod bcol la 'jigs mi bya/ /de nas bsad sngags bzlas pa ni/ / dmigs pa sngar bzhin 'bod sngags bzlas/ /gtor mchod bstod rjes 'di bzlas so/ /ā+oṃ a kro te ka hrī shag ru raṃ/ ma ma yong za/ 'gram ha hi kā la dza dzaḥ de ltar zhag bdun bar du bsgrubs/ /de nas sngar bzhin gtor ma'i rjes/ /bsad sngags ming dang spel la bsgrub/ /de ltar zhag grangs nyi shu gcig /song rjes ling ga bsregs pa yi/ /thal ba mnan la gtor zor 'phangs/ /des ni the tshom med pa yin/ /shin tu gsang nas bsgrub pa gces/ /klong chen rab 'byams bdag gis ni/
/gter kha du ma'i gnad mthong zhing*/ /bla ma'i man ngag bcud dril nas/ /skal ldan don du bris pa yin/ /gnad 'di gzhan la ma bstan cig /zab/ a+thi+-iḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)drang srong gi bstod pa/ -PAGE 368--PAGE 369--PAGE 367-
